usage: The term '屋企人' refers to people who live together as a family in the same house.
It can be used to talk about all family members collectively without specifying each person individually.
You can use '屋企人' when talking about events or activities involving family.
It is often used in casual conversation to express familiarity and closeness among family members.
The word is versatile and can apply to immediate family or extended family living under one roof.
